Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.ingestion.web

Class WebPageHarvester

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.ingestion.web.WebPageHarvester
@Component public class WebPageHarvester extends Object
Infrastructure adapter that scrapes configured competitor web pages using jsoup and detects content changes via SHA-256 hashing.

Only pages configured with tier COMPETITOR in FeedSourceProperties are processed. On each harvest cycle the adapter fetches the page HTML, extracts the main content area (falling back to <body> if no semantic container is found), computes a SHA-256 digest, and compares it against the stored hash via ContentHashPort. Changed (or first-seen) pages are returned as NewsArticle records ready for persistence in the existing pipeline.

Each detected change produces a new NewsArticle whose URL includes a #snapshot-{epochSeconds} fragment to bypass the URL-based deduplication in ArticleStorageAdapter.
